# Original Look Upholstery

> Boat, auto & furniture upholstery based in Pflugerville, Texas. Boat interiors, car seats and dining chairs, reupholstered by Vera and her husband in their Pflugerville shop. Pick from a big selection of samples and get it back looking like new, or better.

- Phone: (512) 696-3582
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Service area: Pflugerville, Austin, Round Rock, Hutto, Manor, Georgetown
- Google rating: 4.7 from 63 reviews
- Request a quote: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/upholstery/texas/original-look-upholstery/quote.html
- Book a drop-off: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/upholstery/texas/original-look-upholstery/book.html

## Services
- Boat upholstery: Seats, bolsters and full wake-boat interiors in marine vinyl, matched to your boat's colors.
- Auto upholstery: Torn, cracked and peeling car seats brought back, so the interior looks right again.
- Furniture reupholstery: Dining chairs and heirloom pieces with new foam and new fabric, often better than the original.

## About
Original Look Upholstery is run by Vera and her husband out of their shop at 1502 Massengale St in Pflugerville. Boats, cars and furniture all come through the same door, and the same two people do the work. A lot of it is wake boats: Malibu, Tigé and Centurion interiors redone in marine vinyl with the original look, or a fresh color scheme. One Malibu owner said the work came out better than what came from the factory. The rest is car seats and furniture: torn leather driver's seats, dining chairs that didn't hold up, carved heirloom chairs. Customers pick from a large selection of samples, and Vera helps them choose.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What do you reupholster?
  A: Boat seats and full boat interiors, car seats, and furniture like dining chairs and carved wood chairs. If it has a cushion and a cover, call and ask.
- Q: Do you do wake boats?
  A: Yes. Malibu, Tigé and Centurion interiors come through the shop, from single seats and bolsters to full interiors.
- Q: Can I pick my own fabric or vinyl?
  A: Yes. The shop has a large selection of samples to choose from. Come by Monday to Friday 8 to 5:30 or Saturday 8 to noon.
- Q: Do you pick up and deliver?
  A: Ask Vera when you call. Customers have had dining chairs picked up from their garage and delivered back.
- Q: How long does it take?
  A: It depends on the piece and the material. Call (512) 696-3582 with photos and we'll give you a straight answer.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: 1502 Massengale St, Pflugerville, TX 78660.
